The meme cryptocurrency Dogecoin (#DOGE) is seeing a major rise in value, climbing over 80% in the past week and reaching new 52-week highs. With a market cap of $47.7 billion, 
 #DOGE has surpassed Ford Motors market cap of $44.63 billion. https://t.co/VbQxohNiYD

The SEC has delayed its decision on crypto spot ETFs: VanEck Spot #Solana ETF, Canary Spot #Litecoin ETF, Canary Spot Solana ETF, Canary Spot #XRP ETF, Grayscale Spot XRP ETF, and Grayscale Spot #Dogecoin ETF
